Title: Meet Ayven: Alknoma's AI Automation That Turns Busy Work Into Real Outcomes - Alknoma
# Meet Ayven: Alknoma's AI Automation That Turns Busy Work Into Real Outcomes. And handoffs across time zones should work like a well-oiled machine. Employees are spending more time coordinating work than executing it. Progress stalls every time someone logs off, breaking down asynchronous work cultures. The reality is AI will not ease workloads until businesses create AI that works for humans, not the other way around. Alknoma is changing this with Ayven, real AI automation built for team operations. Ayven works alongside you in Slack and Teams and connects with your digital tools to gain context of your workflows. Asynchronous work—where employees work on their own schedules, without relying on real-time interaction—is heavily relied upon today. With teams spread across time zones, async work is essential in theory. Working across time zones makes this worse. What's needed isn't AI layered on top of this broken system to generate even more work. **AI automation for async teams who are tired of pretending it's working**. And the work culture isn't really asynchronous if it depends on everyone being online at the same time. Ayven is built to create a digital work environment that doesn't bottleneck. Ayven uses a human-in-the-loop approach to gate sensitive actions that require work from colleagues. Instead of forcing handoffs when the work is not quite ready and trying to catch colleagues before they log off, Ayven bridges the gap between you and your team members across time zones. Ayven walks each employee through a short intro flow to learn their role, availability preferences, and working hours. ### Execute work that's superior to other AI tools. Ayven produces finished AI-executed work with all the nuance from your tech stack. The result is AI outputs that close work loops and a workday that actually ends, so progress doesn't depend on you bringing work home with you. Alknoma unlocks this next frontier of AI productivity by giving all employees access to AI automation that helps them work optimally. * Prevent work from becoming siloed across teams, time zones, and projects. * Reclaim time to execute human-led creative and strategic work. Or does it only work when everyone is quietly online at the same time?

How it works

Thirty minutes. You walk us through where coordination hurts; we show you what Ayven does about it. If it's not a fit, we'll say so.

### Ayven joins your team

We set Ayven up in your Slack or Teams together and start on the workflow that hurts most — the recurring chase, the status ritual, the handoff that keeps stalling.

Every other week we review what worked and what didn't, and what you need next goes onto the roadmap. You approve everything Ayven does — nothing ships without you.

## Frequently asked questions [...] ## Frequently asked questions

What does it cost?
:   The partnership isn't a sales motion — the value is fixing the problem, not the price tag. Design partners don't pay while we build together; commercials come later, on partner terms, once Ayven is earning its place in your operation.

How much of our time does it take?
:   Beyond using Ayven in your normal work, about 30 minutes every other week for a feedback call. Setup is a single session we run with you.

Are we locked in?
:   No. Either side can stop at any time, and your data is yours — we'll remove Ayven from your workspace and delete what it held on request.
